overview: The committee reviewed items from the 2024–2025 Council governing agenda, focusing on DPW and facilities priorities. The committee approved requests for reports on pavement and sidewalk management plans, in-house road repair staffing, and public utility street restoration standards.

items.title: Review of 2024-2025 Council Governing Agenda
items.summary: The committee reviewed its governing agenda priorities, approving motions requesting DPW reports on past pavement and sidewalk management spending, a cost analysis for an in-house sidewalk and hot top crew, and utility standards for street openings.

items.title: Resolution 19-554: Noise Barriers along Route 93
items.summary: The committee discussed a held-over 2019 resolution regarding sound barriers along Route 93 and heard resident public comment calling for barrier installation on the east side of the highway.
